notes: Dev RBox revision: flips a property that holds by geometry (if A is diametrically opposite B, B is diametrically opposite A) to its opposite. antipode_of is also functional, but functionality gives no route back to symmetry. The instances are real near-exact antipodal pairs that Wikipedia names but text rarely does (Tangier/Whangarei, Sanya/Arica); the classic pairs were avoided because a model may hold the converse. Yes and no are balanced by phrasing: direct 'asymmetric' (no, then yes), first instance the converse (yes, then no), second whether the fact rules out the converse (no, then yes); the cross-lingual queries ask the first instance. The Chinese term has no built-in direction, so the zh prompt keeps the English structure. hops counts the instance fact in the prompt as the bridge. Spec note for the user: asymmetry is the edited property here, but CRITERIA Rule 12 lists it as not used. Here the instance answers do change, so the logic is sound; the alternative, 'not symmetric', would leave the second instance at no before and after. Kept as an exception for the user to decide.
